data.$description: Data-visualisation roles, independent of application chrome. The eight categorical series keep one hue order in both themes (blue · teal · Qeet · violet · pink · lime · sky/cyan · graphite) and alternate lightness so series stay separable under the common colour-vision deficiencies (worst-case OKLab distance ≥0.046 light / ≥0.061 dark under normal, deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia); every series is ≥3:1 on its surface. Qeet orange is series 3 — present, never automatically dominant. Colour is never the only channel: charts also render legends, labels and ChartDataTable. positive/negative/warning are semantic, from the status ramps — negative is red, never gray.
